findings: Outer upper sides E02 repeat E01B primary arch radii, louvre springs, sill levels and rose levels to CAD-copy precision; use E02 X coordinates, not Z values rotated without an axis transform.
Ground outer side inner/blind-arch spring is+3.100470m; front is+2.899970m. Difference200.5mm is real source data, not a copy artefact.
E02 ground side shows an inner1m arched window with+0.849970m sill inside the decorative blind arch; do not silently substitute the closed front panel or approve glass/material/airflow.

ET has no title/orientation. It corroborates upper window radii/springs but omits the exterior great-arch ornament. Stage2 rose centre is+13.187964m,90mm lower than E02/E01B+13.277964m. Treat ET face identification and this difference as unresolved.

Plans show near-square footprints and bilateral repeated corner/edge contours; cuts at storey boundaries do not prove rear rose level or every rear applied ornament. Rear/inner repeated exterior completion must be labelled DERIVED rather than exact DRAWING SHOWN.

The old balcony vase balusters do not follow E01B: source shows a pierced parapet with squared stepped openings; the plan proves a near-square outer+29.09 outline about5.63m across. E01B top rail at+30.080962 spans5.205m, which is a different height/reference from the plan base outline.
Do not assign the60mm difference between adjacent PT29 band lines as an engineered wall/guard thickness. Preserve attachment, drainage, guarding and structural holds.

E02 is one registered side elevation, not two independently labelled B/H tower side elevations. Applying its profile to the opposite outer tower face uses the documented project mirror symmetry; rear/inner faces remain a separately labelled derived completion.
